headline: Bayer Raises 2026 Profit Forecast on Strong Pharma Performance
summary: Bayer raised its 2026 profit outlook as its pharmaceutical unit surpassed expectations. Shares rose 2% in early Frankfurt trading.
why: Upgraded profit guidance signals stronger-than-expected operational performance in key business divisions, directly boosting investor sentiment and share price.

impacts.name: Bayer AG
impacts.why: Raising profit forecasts improves fundamental equity valuation and drives share price gains.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: An improved profit outlook driven by outperformance in the pharmaceutical unit beats consensus expectations, triggering positive momentum in the stock.
